epoch_policy.rationale: Keep the same number of optimizer exposures per epoch as the Chrono-A1 training split.

class_balance.per_batch_target: approximately half normal and half attack; the odd sample alternates by batch

normal_hierarchy.policy: uniform over profiles available in normal training runs
uniform over active-core-count groups available inside the selected profile
uniform over runs available inside the selected profile and active-core-count group
draw a temporally separated window from the selected run

attack_hierarchy.policy: uniform over attacker counts available inside the selected strength
uniform over profiles available inside the selected strength and attacker-count group
uniform over runs available inside the selected strength, attacker-count and profile group
draw a temporally separated window from the selected run

missing_cell_policy.rule: Only choose among values that actually exist below the already selected parent group.

placement_policy.active_core_placement: covered by run-uniform selection; not a separate balancing level
placement_policy.attacker_placement: covered by run-uniform selection; not a separate balancing level
placement_policy.reason: Avoid a sparse Cartesian product and excessive oversampling of rare exact placements.

temporal_separation.preferred_run_diversity: use every eligible run once within a branch before reusing a run when feasible
temporal_separation.candidate_policy: prefer indices whose end_epoch differs from previously selected windows of the same run in the current batch by at least the temporal window length
temporal_separation.fallback: if no valid candidate exists after bounded retries, choose the farthest available end_epoch and count a temporal-collision event

randomness.worker_seed: derived deterministically from epoch seed and worker id
